integrity: The feasibility criterion is an exact rewriting of the two defining conditions using multipartite open neighborhoods. The enumerator then counts each feasible part-count array by independent multinomial choices. Direct exhaustive verification agrees coefficientwise through order eight.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs and signed total Roman dominating functions.
The theorem enumerates single functions, not signed total Roman domatic families.
The exhaustive verifier covers total order at most eight; the arbitrary-order result is analytic.
Full-text inspection of arXiv:2606.27175 was blocked by transport in this run, so the originality comparison to that preprint relies on accessible abstract-level scope plus targeted searches.
title: Weight enumerator of signed total Roman dominating functions on complete multipartite graphs
